patterns.notes: Ambient — plays on world wake-up regardless of habit levels, matches the fog effect already built in the web prototype.
Slow palette drift (spring->summer->autumn->winter) tied to consistency, not a discrete overlay.

notes: Weather is always additive/positive per the spec — nothing here should read as punishing. Multiple patterns can be simultaneously active (e.g. rain + drifting_clouds); the renderer layers them rather than switching between exclusive states.
